title: Assess Quando? for ADHD users and propose a focus mode
note: Approved: a narrow, free focus block after the 4 Dec public release. Plan-update suggestions laid in the three plans. Nothing built.
details: What helps, what gets in the way, the gaps, how other apps serve ADHD users, a focus mode proposal, which updates the business, marketing and market plans need, and how to reach this audience. All five decisions are approved: the focus block after release, free for everyone, a first-run choice, a voluntary tester question with five interviews in each person's preferred format, and plan updates as suggestions. Waiting on the freeze to end before any build.
